instruction: Place the bread loaf medium-sized and the bread loaf medium-sized into the medium-sized breadbasket.

source.instruction: Place the bread loaf medium-sized and the bread loaf medium-sized into the medium-sized breadbasket.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the breadbasket, which was at x = -0 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above the nearer bread loaf at (20, -10, 94) and orient for grasp.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-11, +9, -0) cm, now 22 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket
